Bill.BriefDescription: Promoting economic development by providing information to businesses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to promoting economic development by providinginformation to businesses; and amending RCW 19.02.050.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 19.02.050 and 2011 c 298 s 6 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: ((The legislature hereby directs the full participation by thefollowing agencies)) (1) Each of the following agencies must developwith the department of revenue a timetable to, by 2015, fullyparticipate in the implementation of this chapter: (((1))) (a) Department of agriculture; (((2))) (b) Secretary of state; (((3))) (c) Department of social and health services; (((4))) (d) Department of revenue; (((5))) (e) Department of fish and wildlife; (((6))) (f) Employment security department; (((7))) (g) Department of labor and industries; (((8) Department of commerce; (9))) (h) Liquor control board; (((10))) (i) Department of health; p. 1 SSB 5680 (((11))) (j) Department of licensing; (((12) Parks and recreation commission; (13))) (k) Utilities and transportation commission; ((and (14))) (l) Board of accountancy; (m) Department of archaeology and historic preservation; (n) Department of early learning; (o) Department of ecology; (p) Department of financial institutions; (q) Department of transportation; (r) Gambling commission; (s) Horse racing commission; (t) Office of the insurance commissioner; (u) State lottery; (v) Student achievement council; (w) Washington state patrol; (x) Workforce training and education coordinating board; and (y) Other agencies as determined by the governor. (2) Each agency will be considered as fully participating uponproviding the department with the application and the informationidentifying the requirements to complete the application for everybusiness license issued by the agency. (3) Unless provided otherwise in the timetable established undersubsection (1) of this section, each agency, using a format acceptableto the department, must certify its full participation to thedepartment by the November 1st of each year, beginning November 1,2013. If an agency has not submitted all the licensing informationnecessary for full participation, the agency must instead submit aprogress report and explanation to the department. The departmentshall compile the information submitted by each agency, and submit anaggregate report to the governor and the economic developmentcommittees of the legislature by January 1st of each year, beginningJanuary 1, 2014.
